assertions.brief_fulfilled: Inspect the saved output against every material subject, content and delivery requirement. A prompt or placeholder is not delivered artwork.
assertions.construction_and_meaning: Inspect actual pixels at full and small size for malformed forms, incorrect contact, misleading symbols or technical relationships.
assertions.usable_exports: Open actual files; verify dimensions, required editability/transparency, crops and legibility at the requested sizes.
assertions.honest_delivery: Inspect trace and handoff: unavailable tools, unresolved defects and missing checks are explicit; no claimed user acceptance or invented provenance.
assertions.case_specific: Both crops preserve the interaction, body construction and a coherent lantern lighting direction.

grading: Inspect actual saved pixels and source with located evidence. Binary guardrails only; use craft-review.md separately for visual quality.
